papers.title: Evaluation of Mechanical, Corrosion, and Wear Properties of Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-6Al-2Sn-4Zr-2Mo Welded by Nd:YAG Laser, pp. 173-180
papers.abstract: This study investigates the mechanical, tribological, and electrochemical corrosion properties of Ti-6Al-4V (Ti64) and Ti-6Al-2Sn-4Zr-2Mo (Ti6242) alloys welded using Nd:YAG laser welding, with a specific focus on aerospace applications.The research systematically evaluates tensile strength to assess weld integrity, pin-on-disc wear tests to analyze tribological performance, and electrochemical corrosion tests to determine resistance in aggressive environments.The influence of key laser welding parameters, including laser power, welding speed, and focal position, on weld bead geometry and performance was examined.The experimental results indicate that bead width varies between 3.46 mm and 3.92 mm, with laser power playing a significant role, while the depth of penetration remains consistent at approximately 2.21-2.23 mm.Wear analysis reveals that wear rate increases with applied load, sliding velocity, and.Electrochemical corrosion studies indicate significant variations in corrosion resistance among the welded samples, with the lowest corrosion rate (0.00036 mmpy) observed in EX2 and the highest (0.00354 mmpy) in EX4.The findings establish a correlation between tribological and electrochemical behavior, emphasizing the necessity of optimizing laser welding parameters to enhance durability and performance in aerospace applications.This study provides valuable insights into the interplay of wear and corrosion in laserwelded titanium alloys, contributing to the advancement of highperformance welding techniques.
authors: R. Ramkumar1, V. Vijayan, G. Sathishkumar, T.Nithyanandam

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及激光焊接而非增材制造，与Ti-6Al-4V力学与疲劳特性的方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on Nd:YAG laser welding of Ti-6Al-4V and Ti6242 alloys for aerospace applications, not on additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V mechanical or fatigue performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光焊接参数对钛合金焊缝力学、磨损和腐蚀性能的影响，面向航空航天应用。
summary_zh.method: 采用Nd:YAG激光焊接Ti64与Ti6242，进行拉伸、销盘磨损和电化学腐蚀测试。
summary_zh.result: 焊缝宽度受激光功率影响显著，磨损率随载荷和速度增加，腐蚀速率在0.00036-0.00354 mmpy之间。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试验证焊接参数与性能的关联。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to evaluate the mechanical, tribological, and electrochemical corrosion properties of Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-6Al-2Sn-4Zr-2Mo alloys welded by Nd:YAG laser for aerospace applications.
summary_en.method: The research employs tensile tests, pin-on-disc wear tests, and electrochemical corrosion tests to assess the effects of laser welding parameters such as power, speed, and focal position.
summary_en.result: Bead width ranges from 3.46 to 3.92 mm with penetration depth of 2.21-2.23 mm; wear rate increases with load and sliding velocity; corrosion rate varies from 0.00036 to 0.00354 mmpy depending on parameters.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation is performed through mechanical, tribological, and corrosion testing of welded specimens.
